home.title: Platform console
home.description: Every workspace on the platform, in one place: who they are, how they pay and what they are charged.

sections.tenantsLine: Every organization on the platform: the plan it holds and what it owes.
sections.couponsLine: Discounts on what an organization is charged: issue them, and switch them on or off.

tenants.title: Tenants
tenants.description: Every organization on the platform: its plan, its billing state and how many people use it.
tenants.shown: Showing the newest {shown} of {total}. Search to find the others.
tenants.noMatch: No tenant's name or slug contains “{search}”.
tenants.unread: The tenants couldn't be read. Reload the page to try again.

refusal.held: Billing writes are off in this environment, because its billing is the live payment account. Nothing was sent.
refusal.forbidden: The platform refused: this needs a platform administrator.
refusal.no_request: No billing setup was ever requested for this tenant, so there is nothing to repair. Assign a plan instead.
refusal.not_pending_payment: This tenant is not awaiting payment, so there is nothing to send or repair.
refusal.already_complete: Billing setup is already complete. Resend the payment link instead.
refusal.provisioning_failed: Billing setup did not complete. Nothing was charged. The billing state below is the platform's answer now.
refusal.setup_incomplete: Billing setup never completed, so there is no payment link to resend. Repair the setup first.
refusal.rate_limited: Too many sends. Try again in a minute.
refusal.rate_limited_wait: Too many sends. Try again in {seconds, plural, one {# second} other {# seconds}}.
refusal.link_not_available: This checkout can no longer be resumed. Assign the tenant a plan again.
refusal.email_failed: A new payment link was issued and the old one no longer works, but the email did not send. Try again in a few minutes.
refusal.no_admin: This tenant has no active administrator to send to.
refusal.already_has_plan: This tenant already holds a plan. The page now shows it.
refusal.invalid_plan: That plan can no longer be assigned. Choose another.
refusal.awaiting_payment: This tenant is on a paid plan and has not paid. The onboarding email would let them into setup without paying, so it was not sent. Resend the payment link instead.
refusal.already_onboarded: This tenant has already finished onboarding.
refusal.failed: The console couldn't confirm what happened. The page now shows the tenant as the platform has it.
refusal.invalid_code: A code is 2 to 32 letters, digits, dashes or underscores.
refusal.percent_out_of_range: A percentage is a whole number from 1 to 100.
refusal.amount_required: Enter an amount greater than zero.
refusal.currency_required_for_fixed: A fixed-amount coupon needs a currency.
refusal.invalid_duration: A duration is a whole number of months.
refusal.coupon_inactive: This coupon is disabled. Enable it before giving it.
refusal.coupon_exhausted: This coupon has been given to as many organizations as it allows.
refusal.already_assigned: This organization already has this coupon. Revoke that one first.

detail.missing: There is no tenant with this address.
detail.unread: This tenant couldn't be read. Reload the page to try again.
detail.billingHeld: Billing writes are off in this environment: its billing is the live payment account. Repair, resend, plans and coupons are refused here, and say so.

billingPanel.title: Billing
billingPanel.setupUnread: Couldn't be read. Reload the page to try again.
billingPanel.attemptsCount: {count, plural, =0 {None yet} one {# attempt} other {# attempts}}
billingPanel.attemptsLast: {count, plural, one {# attempt} other {# attempts}}, the last on {at}

resend.label: Resend payment link
resend.what: A new payment link for the same checkout goes to the tenant's first administrator.
resend.old: The link sent before stops working. Nothing is charged here.
resend.done: A new payment link was sent to {email}. The previous link no longer works.

repair.label: Repair billing setup
repair.what: This runs billing setup again for this tenant and, once it is done, emails the payment link.
repair.nothing: It does not charge the customer, activate the plan or grant credits.
repair.doneEmailed: Billing setup is complete. The customer was emailed a payment link.
repair.doneNotEmailed: Billing setup is complete, but the email did not send. Resend the payment link.
repair.impossible: This setup failed in a way that retrying can't fix. Assign the tenant a plan again.

missingPlan.title: This tenant has no plan to work on

why.MISSING: It has no plan, and can't use the product until it is given one.
why.EXPIRED: Its access has ended. It can't use the product until it is given a plan.
why.SETUP_INCOMPLETE: A plan was requested and its setup never finished. Repair it above, or choose a plan below.
why.CONFLICTING: It holds more than one active plan. Nothing was changed automatically: which one is right is a commercial decision.

missingPlan.blocked: Sign-in, account security and billing still work for it. The inbox, AI, channels and everything else do not.
missingPlan.plansUnread: The plans couldn't be read. Reload the page to try again.
missingPlan.plansNone: No plan can be assigned: none is active and public.

assign.label: Assign and request payment
assign.what: {plan} is assigned. The tenant moves to Pending payment and its administrator is emailed a payment link.
assign.nothing: Nothing is charged here, and no access is granted until payment is confirmed.
assign.poc: To give access without charging, set the tenant up as a POC instead.
assign.done: The plan was assigned. The tenant is pending payment and was emailed a payment link.
assign.doneNotEmailed: The plan was assigned and the tenant is pending payment, but the email did not send. Resend the payment link.

disable.label: Disable tenant
disable.what: Nobody in this tenant can sign in until it is enabled again. Nothing is deleted.

enable.label: Enable tenant
enable.what: The tenant's people can sign in again.

onboarding.label: Resend onboarding email
onboarding.what: The tenant's administrator is emailed a new setup link.
onboarding.done: The onboarding email was sent to {email}.

tenantCoupons.title: Coupons
tenantCoupons.what: A coupon discounts what this organization is charged. Its plan and contracted price don't change.
tenantCoupons.unread: This tenant's coupons couldn't be read. Reload the page to try again.
tenantCoupons.fullPrice: Paying full price: no coupon is discounting its charges.
tenantCoupons.liveOpen: Discounted by {codes} right now, with no end date.

revoke.label: Revoke
revoke.what: {code} stops discounting. The next charge is the full plan price.
revoke.done: {code} was revoked. The next charge is the full plan price.

tenantCoupons.assignableUnread: The coupons to give couldn't be read. Reload the page to try again.
tenantCoupons.assignableNone: There is no active coupon to give. Create one in Coupons.

give.label: Give the coupon
give.what: {code} discounts every charge from today for {months, plural, one {# month} other {# months}}.
give.whatOpen: {code} discounts every charge from today until it is revoked.
give.unchanged: The plan and its contracted price don't change.
give.done: The coupon was given. It applies from the next charge.

coupons.title: Coupons
coupons.description: A coupon discounts what an organization is charged. It never changes its plan or its contracted price: when the window closes, the charge returns to the plan price on its own.
coupons.held: Billing writes are off in this environment: its billing is the live payment account. Creating, enabling and disabling coupons are refused here, and say so.
coupons.unread: The coupons couldn't be read. Reload the page to try again.
coupons.empty: No coupon has been issued yet.
coupons.window: {months, plural, one {# month} other {# months}} by default
coupons.given: {count, plural, =0 {Given to no organization} one {Given to # organization} other {Given to # organizations}}

disable.label: Disable
disable.what: {code} stops discounting at once, for every organization it was given to, and can't be given again until it is enabled.
disable.done: {code} is disabled. It stopped discounting everywhere it was given.

enable.label: Enable
enable.what: {code} discounts again wherever its window is still open, and can be given again.

create.title: Create a coupon
create.wholeMonths: A whole number of months, 1 or more.
create.exampleOtherCurrency: A {currency} coupon only discounts charges made in {currency}.
create.exampleFor: On a plan of {price} a month: {example}, every month for {months, plural, one {# month} other {# months}}.
create.exampleOpen: On a plan of {price} a month: {example}, every month until it is revoked.
create.done: The coupon was created. It discounts nothing until it is given to an organization.
